# monetary value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:monetaryValue`](gmeow-monetaryValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/monetaryValue>

- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)
